newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded firms on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded firms on strong demand.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline differentials continued to move higher and diesel fuel differentials were steady in Chicago and Group Three on Wednesday, traders said.

Shell Oil Co said it restarted a 20,000 barrel per day alkylation unit idled by a fire yesterday at its 268,000 barrel per day Woods River, Ill., refinery, and would increase crude runs slightly after the unit was fully back on line.
But the company was still assessing damage to one of two gas plants at the refinery. "It's going to be more than a few days" before the gas plant is restarted, a spokeswoman said.

Chicago unleaded for prompt November deliveries firmed to bids 7.75 cents a gallon over NYMEX December unleaded, with later deliveries firming to 5.75 cents over the print and premium steady at 3.50 cents higher, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was talked 5.0/5.25 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and 1.50/1.75 cent over for later deliveries. Premium was talked 3.0 cents higher.
Low sulphur diesel for prompt deliveries was bid 3.50 cents over the print in Chicago and 5.25 cents over in Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel for later deliveries was bid 2.0 cents over the print in Chicago and 1.75 cent over in Group Three, traders said.
